items.title_cn: ICU级急性胰腺炎早期液体复苏：目标试验模拟——研究设计（方案）
items.title_en: Early Fluid Resuscitation in ICU-level Acute Pancreatitis: Target Trial Emulation — Study Design (Protocol)
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该文献为ICU级急性胰腺炎早期液体复苏的目标试验模拟研究设计协议，无摘要内容可提取具体发现。

items.title_cn: 急性坏死性胰腺炎的管理：当前证据、争议与未来展望
items.title_en: Management of acute necrotizing pancreatitis: Current evidence, controversies and future perspectives
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题聚焦急性坏死性胰腺炎的管理，涵盖当前证据、争议与未来展望，与研究者核心关注的急性/慢性胰腺炎诊治（包括重症胰腺炎的阶梯治疗、内镜下坏死清除术）高度契合。由于未提供摘要，无法基于摘要内容总结具体核心发现。

items.title_cn: 内镜超声在慢性胰腺炎诊断中的应用：结构化最新综述
items.title_en: Endoscopic ultrasound in the diagnosis of chronic pancreatitis: a structured state-of-the-art review.
items.abstract_cn: 慢性胰腺炎（CP）的诊断需综合临床概率、结构影像学以及必要时的胰腺功能检查。在专家中心评估的特定患者中，当核心问题为高概率临床背景下的早期或轻微改变型CP，或当已知局灶性胰腺病变需要详细特征描述或组织获取时，建议将超声内镜（EUS）作为一线检查。这一建议的检查顺序是一种个体化替代方案，可替代推荐将CT或MRI作为疑似CP普通人群初始影像学检查的指南；横断面影像学仍作为替代诊断、并发症评估和病变分期的补充手段。在CT或MRI/MRCP结果不确定后，EUS也具有明确的既定作用。本结构化前沿综述针对预设的临床问题，将成熟实践与辅助性及研究性EUS技术加以区分。采用标准化形态学报告的常规B模式EUS是成熟的内镜技术，尽管观察者间变异性和不完美的特异性限制了其作为独立参考标准的应用。应变弹性成像、对比增强EUS和促胰液素刺激EUS胰腺功能检测可在特定患者中提供硬度、灌注或功能信息。剪切波弹性成像和检测血流成像仍为新兴技术，需要多中心验证和标准化阈值。不建议仅以证明CP为目的进行组织获取，应主要保留用于疑似恶性肿瘤或自身免疫性胰腺炎。逐步路径将特定的EUS一线评估与基于指南的CT/MRI优先顺序加以区分，并整合补充影像学和选择性功能检测。
items.abstract_en: Chronic pancreatitis (CP) is diagnosed by integrating clinical probability, structural imaging and, when required, pancreatic function. Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) is proposed as a first-line investigation in selected patients evaluated in expert centers when the principal question is early or minimal-change CP in a high-probability clinical setting, or when a known focal pancreatic lesion requires detailed characterization or tissue acquisition. This proposed sequence is an individualized alternative to guidance recommending CT or MRI as initial imaging in the general population with suspected CP; cross-sectional imaging remains complementary for alternative diagnoses, complications and lesion staging. EUS also has an established role after inconclusive CT or MRI/MRCP. This structured state-of-the-art review addresses predefined clinical questions and separates established practice from adjunctive and investigational EUS technologies. Conventional B-mode EUS with standardized morphologic reporting is the established endoscopic technique, although interobserver variability and imperfect specificity limit its use as an isolated reference standard. Strain elastography, contrast-enhanced EUS and secretin-stimulated EUS pancreatic function testing can add stiffness, perfusion or functional information in selected patients. Shear wave elastography and detective flow imaging remain emerging technologies requiring multicenter validation and standardized thresholds. Tissue acquisition is not recommended solely to prove CP and should be reserved mainly for suspected malignancy or autoimmune pancreatitis. A stepwise pathway distinguishes selected first-line EUS assessment from the guideline-based CT/MRI-first sequence and integrates complementary imaging and selective functional testing.
items.summary_cn: 该综述提出EUS可作为特定高危人群早期或微小改变型慢性胰腺炎的一线检查，以及已知局灶性病变的精细刻画与取材手段，与指南推荐的CT/MRI首选序列形成个体化替代路径；同时明确常规B模式EUS为成熟技术，而应变弹性成像、对比增强EUS和促胰液素刺激EUS功能检测为附加手段，剪切波弹性成像等仍属待验证的新兴技术，组织取材不应仅用于证实慢性胰腺炎。

items.title_cn: cGAS-STING信号通路在急性胰腺炎中的作用及治疗潜力：从炎症与细胞死亡角度
items.title_en: The role and therapeutic potential of cGAS-STING signaling in acute pancreatitis: from the perspectives of inflammation and cell death
items.abstract_cn: 环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶（cGAS）-干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）信号通路能够识别病原体来源和宿主DNA。该因子触发先天免疫应答，从而建立起针对组织损伤和病原体入侵的广泛而有效的监视机制。在急性胰腺炎（AP）中，cGAS-STING信号通路在胰腺细胞死亡过程中发挥多种调控功能。我们系统综述了cGAS-STING信号通路在急性胰腺炎中的分子机制，总结了该通路与多种程序性细胞死亡形式相互作用的最新研究进展。通过具体案例分析，我们阐述了cGAS-STING信号通路在调控细胞凋亡、自噬、铁死亡、焦亡及炎症反应中的关键作用。最后，本文还探讨了若干天然植物来源化合物的潜在研究价值，这些化合物通过调控该通路从而干预急性胰腺炎病理过程中的细胞死亡机制。
items.abstract_en: The cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling pathway can recognize pathogen-derived and host DNA. This factor triggers innate immune responses and thereby establishes a broad and effective surveillance mechanism for tissue damage and pathogen invasion. In acute pancreatitis (AP), the cGAS-STING signaling pathway exerts diverse regulatory functions during the process of pancreatic cell death. We systematically review the molecular mechanism of the cGAS-STING signaling pathway in acute pancreatitis. We summarize the latest research progress on the interaction of this pathway with various forms of programmed cell death. Through specific case analyses, we elaborate on the key role of the cGAS-STING signaling pathway in regulating apoptosis, autophagy, ferroptosis, pyroptosis and inflammatory responses. Finally, this article also explores the potential research value of several natural plant-derived compounds. They achieve this by regulating this pathway and thereby interfering with the mechanism of cell death during the pathological process of acute pancreatitis.
items.summary_cn: 该综述系统阐述了cGAS-STING信号通路在急性胰腺炎中调控胰腺细胞死亡（凋亡、自噬、铁死亡、焦亡）及炎症反应的分子机制，并探讨了天然植物来源化合物通过调控该通路干预急性胰腺炎病理过程中细胞死亡的潜在研究价值。

items.title_cn: 搜索增强大语言模型在急性胰腺炎中的临床安全阈值与决策风险：面向外科实践的指南锚定评估
items.title_en: Clinical Safety Thresholds and Decision Risks of Search-Augmented Large Language Models in Acute Pancreatitis: A Guideline-Anchored Evaluation for Surgical Practice
items.abstract_cn: 背景 患者和临床医生越来越多地使用搜索增强型大语言模型（LLMs）进行即时决策支持。然而，其对新修订指南的安全阈值仍未得到验证。本研究以2025年IAP/APA急性胰腺炎指南为基准，建立了评估ChatGPT-5.3和Gemini 3.0 Flash的临床准确性、完整性、质量和可读性的安全基线。方法 使用零样本提示词查询了涵盖诊断、管理、干预和出院共27个共识衍生的临床场景。三名盲法普外科医生使用5点Likert量表评估输出的准确性、完整性和全局质量评分（GQS），同时采用二分类错误指标。可读性通过FRES、FKGL和SMOG指数进行量化。评估者间一致性采用组内相关系数（ICC）进行评估。结果 Gemini在完整性方面显著高于ChatGPT（中位数[IQR]：4.33 [4.33-4.67] vs 4.33 [4.00-4.33]；校正P = .042）；全局质量评分无显著差异（校正P = .231）。临床准确性相当（P = .217）。应答级幻觉率相似（ChatGPT：25.9% vs Gemini：22.2%；P = 1.000）。Gemini组发生了一例致命错误（主张过早行坏死组织清除术）（3.7%）。高分集中导致天花板效应，削弱了ICC值。两种模型均处于12年级阅读水平。ChatGPT的质量与字数呈正相关（ρ = 0.419，P < .05），而Gemini保持了与篇幅无关的信息密度。结论 两种LLM对2025年IAP/APA指南均表现出较强的基线保真度。然而，持续存在的关键错误和高学术阅读水平阻碍了自主部署。建立这一安全底线是开展人在环路中可用性试验的必要前提，应将LLM严格定位为受监督的临床副驾驶。
items.abstract_en: Background Patients and clinicians increasingly consult search-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs) for point-of-care decision support. However, their safety thresholds against newly revised guidelines remain unverified. This study established a safety baseline evaluating the clinical accuracy, completeness, quality, and readability of ChatGPT-5.3 and Gemini 3.0 Flash anchored to the 2025 IAP/APA acute pancreatitis guidelines. Methods Twenty-seven consensus-derived clinical scenarios spanning diagnosis, management, intervention, and discharge were queried using zero-shot prompts. Three blinded general surgeons evaluated outputs using 5-point Likert scales for accuracy, completeness, and Global Quality Score (GQS), alongside binary error metrics. Readability was quantified via FRES, FKGL, and SMOG indices. Inter-rater agreement was assessed using Intraclass Correlation Coefficients (ICC). Results Gemini demonstrated significantly higher completeness than ChatGPT (median [IQR]: 4.33 [4.33-4.67] vs 4.33 [4.00-4.33]; corrected P = .042); Global Quality Scores did not differ significantly (corrected P = .231). Clinical accuracy was comparable ( P = .217). Response-level hallucination rates were similar (ChatGPT: 25.9% vs Gemini: 22.2%; P = 1.000). One fatal error (advocating premature necrosectomy) occurred in the Gemini cohort (3.7%). High-score concentration induced a ceiling effect, attenuating ICC values. Both models operated at a 12th-grade reading level. ChatGPT’s quality correlated positively with word count (ρ = 0.419, P < .05), whereas Gemini maintained volume-independent density. Conclusion Both LLMs display strong baseline fidelity to the 2025 IAP/APA guidelines. However, persistent critical errors and high academic reading levels preclude autonomous deployment. Establishing this safety floor is an indispensable prerequisite for human-in-the-loop usability trials, positioning LLMs strictly as supervised clinical co-pilots.
items.summary_cn: 该研究以2025 IAP/APA急性胰腺炎指南为锚定标准，评估了ChatGPT-5.3与Gemini 3.0 Flash在27个临床场景中的准确性、完整性、质量与可读性，发现两者总体忠实度较高但均存在幻觉（约22%–26%）及关键错误（Gemini出现1例主张过早坏死清除的致命错误），且可读性停留在12年级水平，尚不支持自主临床应用。

items.title_cn: 527例胆总管结石患者ERCP术后胰腺炎的危险因素：回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Risk factors for post-ERCP pancreatitis in 527 patients with choledocholithiasis: A retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 胆总管结石是胆道梗阻和急性胆管炎的常见原因，需要及时治疗。内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）仍是首选治疗方法，但存在ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）的风险，这是最常见的严重不良事件。方法 本回顾性单中心队列研究在Colentina临床医院开展。目的是识别与胆总管结石患者发生ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）相关的患者因素和操作相关因素。该研究还提供了来自东欧三级中心的数据，该地区目前在文献中代表性不足。接受ERCP的患者从机构数据库中识别，并分为发生PEP的病例组和未发生PEP的对照组。收集人口学、临床、操作及术后数据，并进行全面的统计分析，包括单因素和多因素方法，以识别PEP的独立预测因素。结果 在527例胆总管结石患者中，68例（12.9%）发生ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）。PEP组中女性更为常见（75.0% vs. 57.7%，p = 0.007），中位年龄为68岁。PEP组既往胆囊切除术史较少见（17.6% vs. 36.2%，p = 0.003），而胆总管（CBD）中位直径较大（15.8 mm [四分位距（IQR）12–18] vs. 14 mm [IQR 10–16]；p = 0.014）。预切开括约肌切开术（22.1% vs. 7.6%，p < 0.001）、主胰管（MPD）插管（42.6% vs. 10.9%，p < 0.001）及向MPD注射造影剂（14.7% vs. 3.5%，p < 0.001）在发生PEP的患者中更为常见。在多因素分析中，女性、较大的CBD直径、MPD插管及管内碎石术与PEP相关，而既往胆囊切除术与较低风险相关。预切开括约肌切开术显示临界相关性。ERCP术后出血发生于16例患者（3.0%），未观察到穿孔或ERCP术后胆管炎病例。总死亡率为2.1%，PEP组与非PEP组之间无显著差异（5.9% vs. 1.5%，p = 0.20）。结论 PEP仍然是ERCP最重要的并发症之一，对患者发病率及潜在死亡率有重大影响。更加关注操作风险意识和预防策略可能有助于减少其发生并提高治疗性ERCP的整体安全性。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background Choledocholithiasis, a common cause for biliary obstruction and acute cholangitis, requires prompt treatment. Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) remains first-line therapy but carries a risk of post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP), the most common serious adverse event. Methods This retrospective, single-center cohort study was conducted at Colentina Clinical Hospital. The aim was to identify patient and procedure-related factors associated with the development of post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP) in patients with choledocholithiasis. The study also provides data from an eastern European tertiary center, a region currently under-represented in literature. Patients undergoing ERCP were identified from the institutional database and divided into cases who developed PEP and controls without PEP. Demographic, clinical, procedural and post-procedural data was collected and subjected to comprehensive statistical analyses, including univariate and multi-variate methods, to identify independent predictors of PEP. Results Among 527 patients with choledocholithiasis, 68 (12.9%) developed post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP). Female sex was more frequent among patients with PEP (75.0% vs. 57.7%, p = 0.007) and the median age was 68 years. Previous cholecystectomy was less common in the PEP group (17.6% vs. 36.2%, p = 0.003), while median common bile duct (CBD) diameter was greater (15.8 mm [interquartile range (IQR) 12–18] vs. 14 mm [IQR 10–16]; p = 0.014). Pre-cut sphincterotomy (22.1% vs. 7.6%, p < 0.001), main pancreatic duct (MPD) cannulation (42.6% vs. 10.9%, p < 0.001) and contrast injection into the MPD (14.7% vs. 3.5%, p < 0.001) were more frequent in patients who developed PEP. In the multi-variable analysis, female sex, larger CBD diameter, MPD cannulation and intra-ductal lithotripsy were associated with PEP, while prior cholecystectomy was associated with a lower risk. Pre-cut sphincterotomy showed a borderline association. Post-ERCP bleeding occurred in 16 patients (3.0%), while no cases of perforation or post-ERCP cholangitis were observed. Overall mortality was 2.1%, without significant difference between the PEP and non-PEP groups (5.9% vs. 1.5%, p = 0.20). Conclusions PEP continues to be one of the most important complications of ERCP, contributing substantially to patient morbidity and potential mortality. A greater focus on procedural risk awareness and prevention strategies may help reduce its occurrence and improve the overall safety of therapeutic ERCP.
items.summary_cn: 在527例胆总管结石行ERCP的患者中，12.9%发生术后胰腺炎（PEP）；多因素分析显示女性、胆总管直径较大、主胰管插管及管内碎石与PEP风险升高相关，而既往胆囊切除术与较低风险相关，预切开乳头括约肌切开呈边缘性关联。

items.title_cn: ERCP后的等待窗口：胆囊切除术时机与胆道再入院
items.title_en: The Waiting Window After ERCP: Cholecystectomy Timing and Biliary Readmission
items.abstract_cn: 背景：患者在接受内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）后等待胆囊切除术期间，可能需要再次因胆道原因入院。目的：探讨计划性ERCP至胆囊切除术的时间间隔与术前非计划性胆道入院之间的关联。方法：本前瞻性观察性研究由金奈Bharat医学院医院消化内科和普通外科于2025年5月至2026年5月联合设计。对因胆结石相关胆总管结石成功接受ERCP并计划行胆囊切除术的成人患者进行随访，观察其术前入院情况。结果：在43例患者的合成示例中，10例（23.3%）发生了非计划性胆道入院。计划7天内手术的患者中入院发生率为2/20（10.0%），计划较晚手术的患者中为8/23（34.8%）。未调整风险比为3.48（95% CI 0.83–14.52；Fisher精确检验P = 0.076）。急性胆囊炎占4例入院，胆管炎占3例，复发性胆管结石占2例，胆石性胰腺炎占1例。结论：示例性数据提示较晚的计划手术与胆道入院之间可能存在关联，但该估计尚不确定。在任何研究结果或结论提交发表之前，需要获得观察性队列的实际数据。关键词：胆道再入院，胆囊切除术，胆总管结石，内镜逆行胰胆管造影术，手术时机
items.abstract_en: Background: Patients may require another biliary admission after endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) while awaiting cholecystectomy. Aim: To examine the association between planned ERCP-to-cholecystectomy timing and unplanned presurgical biliary admission. Methods: This prospective observational study was designed jointly by Gastroenterology and General Surgery at Bharat Medical College Hospital, Chennai, from May 2025 to May 2026. Adults with successful ERCP for gallstone-related common bile duct stones and planned cholecystectomy were followed for admission before surgery. Results: In the synthetic example of 43 patients, ten (23.3%) had an unplanned biliary admission. Admission occurred in 2/20 (10.0%) scheduled for surgery within seven days and 8/23 (34.8%) scheduled later. The unadjusted risk ratio was 3.48 (95% CI 0.83–14.52; Fisher’s exact P = 0.076). Acute cholecystitis accounted for four admissions, cholangitis for three, recurrent duct stones for two, and gallstone pancreatitis for one. Conclusion: The illustrative data suggest a possible association between later planned surgery and biliary admission, but the estimate is uncertain. The observed cohort data are required before any study result or conclusion can be submitted for publication. Keywords: Biliary readmission, Cholecystectomy, Choledocholithiasis, Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography, Surgical timing
items.journal: Journal of Medicine Pharmacology and Medical Devises Technology
items.summary_cn: 该前瞻性观察研究显示，在成功ERCP治疗胆总管结石并计划行胆囊切除术的患者中，23.3%出现术前非计划胆道再入院；计划手术在7天内者再入院率为10.0%，晚于7天者为34.8%，未校正风险比为3.48（95% CI 0.83–14.52，P=0.076），提示较晚的计划手术可能与胆道再入院相关但估计不确定。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎并发广泛动脉血栓形成：一例病例报告及文献综述
items.title_en: Extensive Arterial Thrombosis Complicating Acute Pancreatitis: A Case Report and Literature Review.
items.abstract_cn: 动脉血栓形成是急性胰腺炎一种罕见但可能危及生命的并发症，其临床特征尚不明确。本文报道一例广泛大动脉血栓形成并发急性间质水肿性胰腺炎的病例，并进行文献综述。一名61岁男性，在慢性胰腺炎基础上发生急性间质水肿性胰腺炎，因持续性消化不良在初次就诊四周后接受增强计算机断层扫描。影像学显示胰腺假性囊肿及广泛动脉血栓形成，累及胸主动脉和腹主动脉、双侧髂内动脉及左锁骨下动脉。患者接受全身抗凝治疗，影像学结果恢复正常。文献综述共检索到11例既往报道的急性胰腺炎相关动脉血栓形成病例。包括本例在内（n=12），5例发生于间质水肿性胰腺炎，7例发生于急性坏死性胰腺炎。主动脉和主要内脏动脉是最常受累的血管。7例在发病第一周内检出动脉血栓形成，而5例诊断较晚，其中1例迟至60天。动脉血栓形成可发生于坏死性胰腺炎和间质性胰腺炎，并可在病程早期或较晚期出现。提高认识和及时影像学检查有助于早期识别和管理。
items.abstract_en: Arterial thrombosis is a rare but potentially life-threatening complication of acute pancreatitis, with poorly defined clinical characteristics. This paper presents a case of extensive large-artery thrombosis complicating acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis along with a literature review. A 61-year-old man with acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis superimposed on chronic pancreatitis underwent contrast-enhanced computed tomography four weeks after the initial presentation because of persistent dyspepsia. The imaging revealed pancreatic pseudocysts and extensive arterial thrombosis involving the thoracic and abdominal aorta, bilateral internal iliac arteries, and the left subclavian artery. The patient was treated with systemic anticoagulation, resulting in radiologic resolution. A literature review identified 11 previously reported cases of acute pancreatitis-associated arterial thrombosis. Including the present case (n=12), five cases occurred in interstitial edematous pancreatitis, while seven developed in acute necrotizing pancreatitis. The aorta and major visceral arteries were the most frequently involved vessels. Arterial thrombosis was detected within the first week in seven cases, whereas five cases were diagnosed later, including one as late as 60 days. Arterial thrombosis can occur in necrotizing and interstitial pancreatitis and may present either early or later in the disease course. Awareness and timely imaging may facilitate prompt recognition and management.

items.summary_cn: 本文报道一例急性间质水肿性胰腺炎并发广泛大动脉血栓形成（累及胸腹主动脉、双侧髂内动脉及左锁骨下动脉），经全身抗凝治疗后影像学消退；结合文献复习12例分析显示，动脉血栓既可发生于坏死性胰腺炎也可发生于间质水肿性胰腺炎，可早至首周内或迟至60天出现，主动脉及主要内脏动脉最常受累。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
